# Water Cleaning Script

## Import Raw Location and Parameter Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
water_dir = data_dir / "water"
```

```{python}
values_path = water_dir / "all_water_values.csv"
locations_path = water_dir / "all_monitoring_locations.csv"
parameters_path = water_dir / "parameter_info.csv"
```

```{python}
locations_df =  pd.read_csv(locations_path, dtype = str)
parameters_df = pd.read_csv(parameters_path, dtype = str)
```

```{python}
chunk_size = 200_000
```

## Parameter Analysis


### Find Unique Values

```{python}
#max_chunks = 1
values_output_path = water_dir / "unique_parameter_names.csv"

if values_output_path.exists():
    unique_values_df = pd.read_csv(values_output_path, dtype=str)
    print(f"{values_output_path} already exists, skipping unique-parameter export.")
else:
    all_values = []

    for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize = chunk_size)):
        #if i > max_chunks:
            #break

        merged = chunk.merge(
            locations_df,
            left_on = "monitoring_location_id",
            right_on = "id",
            how = "left",
            copy = False
        )

        merged = merged.merge(
            parameters_df,
            left_on = "parameter_code",
            right_on = "id",
            how = "left",
            copy = False
        )

        all_values.extend(merged['parameter_name'].dropna().unique())

        print(f"chunk {i} done, moving onto next chunk")

    unique_values_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "parameter_name": sorted(pd.Series(all_values).dropna().unique())
        })

    unique_values_df.to_csv(values_output_path, index = False)
```

### Find Missingness for each unique parameter

```{python}
missingness_output_path = water_dir / "county_parameter_missingness.csv"

if missingness_output_path.exists():
    print(f"{missingness_output_path} already exists, skipping county-parameter summary.")
else:
    summary_rows = []

    for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize=chunk_size)):
        merged = chunk.merge(
            locations_df,
            left_on="monitoring_location_id",
            right_on="id",
            how="left",
            copy=False
        )

        merged = merged.merge(
            parameters_df,
            left_on="parameter_code",
            right_on="id",
            how="left",
            copy=False
        )

        merged["time"] = pd.to_datetime(merged["time"], errors="coerce")
        merged["year"] = merged["time"].dt.year

        temp = merged[["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"]].dropna()
        temp = temp.drop_duplicates(subset=["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"])
        temp["present"] = 1

        summary_rows.append(temp)

        print(f"chunk {i} done, moving onto next chunk")

    parameter_present_df = pd.concat(summary_rows, ignore_index=True)

    parameter_present_df = (
        parameter_present_df
        .groupby(["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"], as_index=False)
        .agg(present=("present", "max"))
    )

    county_years = parameter_present_df[["county_fips", "year"]].drop_duplicates()
    total_count = len(county_years)

    county_year_missingness = (
        parameter_present_df
        .groupby("parameter_name", as_index=False)
        .agg(present_count=("present", "sum"))
        .sort_values("present_count", ascending=False)
    )

    county_year_missingness["total_count"] = total_count
    county_year_missingness["missing_count"] = (
        county_year_missingness["total_count"] - county_year_missingness["present_count"]
    )
    county_year_missingness["missing_rate"] = (
        county_year_missingness["missing_count"] / county_year_missingness["total_count"]
    )

    county_year_missingness = county_year_missingness.sort_values(
        "missing_rate", ascending = True
    )

    county_year_missingness.to_csv(missingness_output_path, index=False)
```

### Split out each parameter into it's own csv for further analysis

```{python}
# Create Directories
split_dir = water_dir / "parameter_splits"
split_dir.mkdir(parents = True, exist_ok = True)

temp_dir = split_dir / "_chunk_temp"
temp_dir.mkdir(parents = True, exist_ok = True)

processed_chunks_path = split_dir / "processed_chunks.csv"

# Grab all unique parameters
values_to_split = unique_values_df["parameter_name"].dropna().tolist()

# If we've already processed some chunks, check which one's we've processed
if processed_chunks_path.exists():
    processed_df = pd.read_csv(processed_chunks_path, dtype = int)
    processed_chunks = set(processed_df["chunk_index"])
else:
    processed_chunks = set()

# Loop over each chunk to write to csv
for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype = str, chunksize = chunk_size)):
    # If we already processed a chunk don't do it again
    if i in processed_chunks:
        print(f"Chunk {i} already processed, skipping.")
        continue

    # Get rid of any temp files from a previous run, so we don't accidentally re-write any data
    for old_temp in temp_dir.glob(f"chunk_{i}_*.csv"):
        old_temp.unlink()

    # Merge locations and parameters tables into the values chunk
    merged = chunk.merge(
        locations_df,
        left_on = "monitoring_location_id",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    merged = merged.merge(
        parameters_df,
        left_on = "parameter_code",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    # make times datetime and create a year column for easier EDA
    merged["time"] = pd.to_datetime(merged["time"], errors = "coerce")
    merged["year"] = merged["time"].dt.year

    # Make numeric columns numeric
    for x in ["value", "longitude", "latitude"]:
        merged[x] = pd.to_numeric(merged[x], errors = "coerce")

    chunk_temp_files = [] # We'll need this for creating temp files later

    # Loop over our unique parameters
    for param in values_to_split:
        param_df = merged[merged["parameter_name"] == param].copy() # Create a new df for just this parameter

        # If there are no instances of this parameter just skip it
        if param_df.empty: 
            continue

        # We don't need the whole table, there's some metadata that's not super useful
        param_df = param_df[[
            "monitoring_location_id",
            "monitoring_location_name",
            "time",
            "year",
            "parameter_name",
            "unit_of_measure_x",
            "value",
            "county_fips",
            "parameter_group_code",
            "parameter_description",
            "medium",
            "longitude",
            "latitude"
        ]]

        # Drop any duplicates in case some snuck in
        param_df = param_df.drop_duplicates(subset = [
            "monitoring_location_id",
            "time",
            "parameter_name",
            "unit_of_measure_x",
            "value",
            "longitude",
            "latitude"
        ])

        # There are too many characters as-is to make a readable csv file
        safe_name = (
            param.lower()
            .replace(' ', "_")
            .replace(',', '')
            .replace("/", "_")
            )

        # Save to a temp file and update chunk_temp_files to store which temp files have been saved already
        temp_file = temp_dir / f"chunk_{i}_{safe_name}.csv"
        param_df.to_csv(temp_file, index = False)
        chunk_temp_files.append((safe_name, temp_file))

    # Now append our temp files to the final files
    for safe_name, temp_file in chunk_temp_files:
        final_file = split_dir / f"{safe_name}.csv"
        write_header = not final_file.exists()

        temp_df = pd.read_csv(temp_file)
        temp_df.to_csv(final_file, mode = "a", header = write_header, index = False)

        temp_file.unlink()

    # Update our processed chunks file and let user know how many chunks they've got through so far
    processed_chunks.add(i)
    pd.DataFrame({"chunk_index": sorted(processed_chunks)}).to_csv(processed_chunks_path, index = False)

    print(f"chunk {i} done, split files updated")
```

### Parameter-Level EDA

```{python}
# User-defined parameter list (safe names)
parameter_list = ["pH"]

for param in parameter_list:
    # Create file path
    file_path = split_dir / f"{param}.csv"

    # If file path doesn't exist, parameter_list probably wasn't specified correctly
    if not file_path.exists():
        print(f"No file found for {param}, please double-check csv file name. Skipping.")
        continue

    # Create an obvious break for easier reading in terminal
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype = str)
    print("\n" + "=" * 40)
    print(f"EDA for {param}")

    # Convert columns to correct types
    for col in ["value", "longitude", "latitude", "year"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"], errors="coerce")

    # Do some basic statistics
    print("\nBasic Statistical Summary:")
    summary = {
        "rows": len(df),
        "non_null_values": df["value"].notna().sum(),
        "missing_value_rate": df["value"].isna().mean(),
        "min_value": df["value"].min(),
        "max_value": df["value"].max(),
        "median_value": df["value"].median(),
        "mean_value": df["value"].mean(),
        "unique_counties": df["county_fips"].nunique(),
        "unique_years": df["year"].nunique(),
        "min_year": df["year"].min(),
        "max_year": df["year"].max(),
        "unique_monitoring_locations": df["monitoring_location_id"].nunique()

    }
    pd.set_option("display.float_format", "{:,.2f}".format)
    print(pd.Series(summary))
    for x in ["unit_of_measure_x", "parameter_group_code", "parameter_description", "medium"]:
        print(f"\n{x}(s): {df[x].dropna().unique()}")

    # Histograms by year and value
    for i in ["year", "value"]:
        plt.figure(figsize = (8, 4))
        if i == "value":
            cap = df[i].quantile(0.999) # cuts off extreme outliers
            plot_data = df[i].clip(upper=cap)
            bins = 40
        else:
            plot_data = df[i]
            bins = 22
        sns.histplot(plot_data.dropna(), bins = bins, kde = False)
        plt.title(f"{i} Distribution for {param}")
        plt.xlabel(i)
        plt.ylabel("Count")
        plt.show()

    # Geographical Missingness
    ## County FIPS json by plotly
    with urllib.request.urlopen(
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/geojson-counties-fips.json"
    ) as response:
        counties_geojson = json.load(response)

    ## Get unique years
    years = sorted(df["year"].dropna().unique())

    frames = []

    ## make one frame per year for time analysis
    for year in years:
        df_year = df[df["year"] == year].copy()

        county_overlay = (
            df_year[["county_fips"]]
            .dropna()
            .drop_duplicates()
            .assign(has_data = 1)
        )

        choropleth = go.Choroplethmap(
            geojson=counties_geojson,
            locations=county_overlay["county_fips"],
            z=county_overlay["has_data"],
            featureidkey="id",
            colorscale=[[0, "#fff9f9"], [1, "#338eca"]],
            zmin=0,
            zmax=1,
            marker_opacity=0.35,
            marker_line_width=0.3,
            showscale=False,
            hovertemplate="County FIPS: %{location}<br>Has data: Yes<extra></extra>"
        )

        points = (
            df_year
            .dropna(subset = ["latitude", "longitude"])
            .drop_duplicates(subset = ["latitude", "longitude"])
            .copy()
        )

        scatter = go.Scattermap(
            lat = points["latitude"],
            lon = points["longitude"],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(
                size=5,
                color="red",
                opacity=0.55
            ),
            text=points["monitoring_location_name"] if "monitoring_location_name" in points.columns else None,
            customdata=points[["county_fips", "value"]] if {"county_fips", "value"}.issubset(points.columns) else None,
            hovertemplate=(
                "Site: %{text}<br>"
                "County FIPS: %{customdata[0]}<br>"
                "Value: %{customdata[1]}<br>"
                "Lat: %{lat}<br>"
                "Lon: %{lon}<extra></extra>"
            ) if {"county_fips", "value"}.issubset(points.columns) else None,
            showlegend=False
        )

        frames.append(
            go.Frame(
                data=[choropleth, scatter],
                name=str(int(year))
            )
        )

    if not frames:
        print(f"No valid yearly data found for {param}")
        continue

    fig = go.Figure(
        data = frames[0].data,
        frames = frames
    )
        
    fig.update_layout(
        title=f"{param}: county coverage + monitoring points by year",
        map=dict(
            style="carto-positron",
            center=dict(lat=37.8, lon=-96),
            zoom=3
        ),
        margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0),
        updatemenus=[
            dict(
                type="buttons",
                showactive=False,
                x=0.05,
                y=0.95,
                buttons=[
                    dict(
                        label="Play",
                        method="animate",
                        args=[
                            None,
                            {
                                "frame": {"duration": 700, "redraw": True},
                                "transition": {"duration": 300},
                                "fromcurrent": True
                            }
                        ]
                    ),
                    dict(
                        label="Pause",
                        method="animate",
                        args=[
                            [None],
                            {
                                "frame": {"duration": 0, "redraw": False},
                                "transition": {"duration": 0},
                                "mode": "immediate"
                            }
                        ]
                    )
                ]
            )
        ],
        sliders=[
            dict(
                active=0,
                currentvalue={"prefix": "Year: "},
                pad={"t": 30},
                steps=[
                    dict(
                        label=str(int(y)),
                        method="animate",
                        args=[
                            [str(int(y))],
                            {
                                "frame": {"duration": 0, "redraw": True},
                                "transition": {"duration": 0},
                                "mode": "immediate"
                            }
                        ]
                    )
                    for y in years
                ]
            )
        ]
    )

    fig.show()
```

## Clean Data

### Aggregate by Year + County

```{python}
output_path = water_dir / "final_data" /"water_data_aggregated.csv"
processed_chunks_path = water_dir / "final_data" / "processed_chunks.csv"

max_chunks = None

values_to_use = ["Dissolved oxygen", "pH", "Temperature, water", "Turbidity, Nephelom", "Specific cond at 25C", "Phosphorus, wu", "Total nitrogen, wu", "Chlorophyll, in situ", "Suspended solids"]

if processed_chunks_path.exists():
    processed_df = pd.read_csv(processed_chunks_path, dtype=int)
    processed_chunks = set(processed_df["chunk_index"])
else:
    processed_chunks = set()

if not processed_chunks and output_path.exists():
    output_path.unlink()

header_written = False if not processed_chunks else True

for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize = chunk_size)):
    if i in processed_chunks:
        print(f"Chunk {i} already processed, skipping.")
        continue

    if max_chunks is not None and i >= max_chunks:
        break

    merged = chunk.merge(
        locations_df,
        left_on = "monitoring_location_id",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    merged = merged.merge(
        parameters_df,
        left_on = "parameter_code",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    combined_df = merged[merged["parameter_name"].isin(values_to_use)].copy()

    combined_df = combined_df[["county_fips", "time", "parameter_name", "value", "unit_of_measure_x"]].reset_index(drop = True)

    combined_df = combined_df.rename(columns={
        "time": "date",
        "unit_of_measure_x": "unit_of_measure",
        "county_fips": "county_id",
        "parameter_name": "parameter"
    })

    combined_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(combined_df["date"], errors="coerce")
    combined_df["value"] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df["value"], errors="coerce")

    combined_df["parameter_unit"] = (
        combined_df["parameter"].str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_", regex = False)
        + "_units_in_"
        + combined_df["unit_of_measure"].str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_", regex = False)
    )

    combined_df["year"] = combined_df["date"].dt.year

    aggregated_df = combined_df.groupby(["county_id", "year", "parameter_unit"], as_index = False).agg(
        sum_value=("value", "sum"),
        count_value=("value", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    aggregated_df.to_csv(output_path, mode = "a", header = not header_written, index = False)
    header_written = True

    print(f"chunk {i} done and {len(aggregated_df):,} rows written")
    
    processed_chunks.add(i)
    pd.DataFrame({"chunk_index": list(processed_chunks)}).to_csv(
        processed_chunks_path, index=False
        )
```

### Create Final DF

```{python}
aggregated_df = pd.read_csv(output_path)

aggregated_df = aggregated_df.groupby(["county_id", "year", "parameter_unit"], as_index = False).sum()

aggregated_df["mean_value"] = aggregated_df["sum_value"] / aggregated_df["count_value"]

df_final = aggregated_df.pivot(
        index = ["county_id", "year"],
        columns = "parameter_unit",
        values = "mean_value"
    ).reset_index()
```
